verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for a SaaS connectivity platform with an admin API, so the story applies. The evidence only touches adjacent material: one community post says API keys exist and expire after 60 days, and the docs cover ACL policy, ephemeral nodes, tsidp OIDC and the Aperture gateway. None of it documents issuing least-privilege or scoped API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
